text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the McCormick Playground Arena Board. This report recommends four candidates for appointment to the board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the McCormick Playground Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 21, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Akim Aliu Regina Azevedo Julie Hoang Nguyen Patrick Rettig
